structures.name: Nieporęt railway bridge
structures.what: Single track steel truss bridge used to develop and test a railway bridge weigh-in-motion system (BridgeMon). Field tests with SiWIM hardware and software, 20 to 25 May 2013, 45 trains recorded.
structures.who: Aleš Žnidarič and Jan Kalin (ZAG) with the University of Surrey, UCD Dublin, Cestel and Adaptronica
src: Hajializadeh, Žnidarič, Kalin, OBrien (2020), Applied Sciences 10(14) 4708

structures.name: Palhoça bridge
structures.what: First bridge weigh-in-motion test in Brazil: SiWIM measurements and soft load testing, calibrated with a three axle and a six axle truck, 13 crossings per lane. Part of the DNIT and ZAG partnership started in 2007.
structures.who: ZAG, Department for Structures, report P 670/220/09-01
src: Shinohara et al., B-WIM for Special Traffic Authorizations in Brazil (cites ZAG 2012)
Linha temporal dos sistemas B-WIM no Brasil (DNIT and ZAG partnership, 2007)

structures.name: Six span bridge near Warsaw
structures.what: Instrumented for a week with the nothing-on-the-road bridge WIM system in the EU project SAMARIS, to show that it works on orthotropic steel decks. Six spans, over 500 m long. The source does not publish the name of the bridge.
src: Kalin, Žnidarič, Lavrič, Practical implementation of nothing-on-the-road bridge WIM

structures.name: Bridges over the Passa Três, Itinguijada and Lambari rivers
structures.what: Monitored by Brazilian partners with SiWIM, the bridge WIM software developed at ZAG, to check special traffic authorisations.
src: Shinohara et al., B-WIM for Special Traffic Authorizations in Brazil
